reasons.story_chant: No story or chant; lesson goes straight to rule and written gap-fills.

reasons.child_tone: Messages short with praise, but the rule uses a 'Wrong:' label.
reasons.age_fit: Food topic and simple words suit an 8-year-old, but the garbled 'place you visited, same point' prompt is confusing.

reasons.story_chant: No story or chant; only rule and gap-fills.

reasons.story_chant: Short clock story and a number chant (five, fifteen, fifty) are given.
reasons.listen_do_steps: 'Listen for clock', 'Point to the clock', 'Say with me' given one at a time.

reasons.teacher_accept: One correct dialogue task, but stalls the learner three times, pointing at an absent clock, ends with a contextless question and ignores 'vive'.

reasons.story_chant: Story (Tom has a ball. The ball is red.) and chant both use a/the.
reasons.listen_do_steps: 'Listen for the', 'Find a ball', 'Say with me', 'Point to the red ball' given one at a time.
reasons.child_tone: Very short warm messages, 'Thank you for trying!', no 'wrong'.
reasons.age_fit: Toys, colours, games and very short sentences suit a 7-year-old.
reasons.teacher_accept: Good modelling of a/the, but the learner's repeated error is never resolved and 'an' is never covered.

reasons.story_chant: Story with 'On Monday...' and a days-of-the-week chant are given.
reasons.listen_do_steps: 'Listen for Monday', 'Say the days', 'Say Monday', 'Say with me' given one at a time.

reasons.teacher_accept: Correct at/on practice, but no rule or modelling of in/on/at before the exercises; the warm-up is mostly days only.

reasons.story_chant: No story or chant; just dialogue examples and rule.

reasons.teacher_accept: 'What time is the lesson?' asked with no dialogue, misspelled 'vour' accepted as right, quarter/half past never taught.

reasons.age_fit: School and daily times in short sentences suit an 8-year-old.
reasons.teacher_accept: 'at' with clock times taught correctly and error corrected with a clear rule; sensible steps.

reasons.story_chant: No story or chant; only rules and rewrite tasks.

reasons.teacher_accept: Correct teaching of capitals, full stops and capital I with sensible steps, but dry written drill with no child-friendly activity.

reasons.listen_do_steps: 'Point to a capital letter' and 'Tell me when you hear it' given one at a time.

reasons.teacher_accept: Target taught and practised correctly, but ignores the child's repeated requests and asks to point at letters with nothing shown.

reasons.story_chant: No story or chant is given.

reasons.story_chant: Story about Sam's family and chant 'Mum, mum, I love my mum' use family words.

reasons.age_fit: Simple, concrete family topic and warm tone suit a 6-year-old.
reasons.teacher_accept: 'This is my'/'She is' practised only late; repeated pointing at an absent picture while ignoring requests.

reasons.story_chant: Story mentions kitchen and chant mentions bedroom, but most target rooms (bathroom, garden) are not in them.
reasons.listen_do_steps: 'Point to the door', 'Show me a chair' given one at a time.
reasons.child_tone: Short, warm, praise for effort ('Good fixing!'), no 'wrong'.
reasons.age_fit: Simple home topic and gentle tone suit a 7-year-old.
reasons.teacher_accept: Only one on-target item (garden); door/chair tasks off-target and 'what we do in each place' barely practised.

reasons.story_chant: 'I am Alex. I am happy' and chant 'I am happy... he is happy, she is happy' use am/is.
reasons.listen_do_steps: 'Say I am happy', 'Listen to Alex again, then say it' given one step at a time.

reasons.age_fit: Very short, concrete, warm messages suit an 8-year-old.
reasons.teacher_accept: Correct am/is/are practice, but the dropped 'am' is never resolved and 'are' is not modelled before the exercise.

reasons.teacher_accept: Correct can + base verb teaching, but 'jumps' error left unaddressed and can't never practised.
